title: Steady
blurb: PCOS/PMOS is a condition that affects 1 in 10 women and to this day there is no definitive 'cure' for the immense number of symptoms and issues it brings to those affected. Steady aims to aid women in symptom management as they navigate changes in their body, medications, and life style choices.

devLog.title: Project kickoff
devLog.text: Started working on project overview and requirements in June of 2026, this phase included reserach on PCOS/PMOS symptoms and an indepth understanding of health tech applications. Most resources used were NIH papers covering both topics.

devLog.title: Prototyping
devLog.text: After laying out all of the required pages (at least initial versions), I began prototyping in Figma, starting with a greyscale version of the pages. Then once the landing pages for each feature were built I added in the desired color pallete. This prototype went up for review as a part of the Hack Your Summer program and showed the overall flow of the application.

devLog.title: Prototyping continued
devLog.text: Once the initial prototyped pages had gotten some feedback i began to add in the sub pages and add 'functionalities' to the buttons and screens in order to show the more advanced flows. This included setting up the sign up and login flows along with the visual symptom tracking flows

devLog.title: Ideation
devLog.text: Framed is a social media platform that combines what I beleive are the best features of some of my favorite apps. Inspired by the styleistc choices of superfan, the algorithmic appraoch of beli and the community of letterboxd I wanted to build something that I would want to use myself. Ive spent a lot of time using these three applications and overtime have come up with the best and worst features of each in order to make an app that I find optimal

devLog.title: Feature Selection
devLog.text:
Acting as Product Owner it was really important to carefully select the feature of the app that would provide the most values, creating a base product that we could build more detailed feature on to. 
 
 After discussion and spending time reseraching other applications we landed on the basic screens including our log-in, list page, profile, add content, and friends. For features the tastemakers feature was decidedly delayed as the ranking algorithm was the most immediate feature a user would want out of the pplication.

devLog.title: Early Prototypes and Design
devLog.text: The design of the app was focused on making a fun interface for users, carefully selecting the color pallete and buttons in order to emphasive creativity and engagement. The prototype was then built in figma, showing the basic flows from screen to screen and we spent 2 weeks working through the design and prototype gaining user feedback on ease of use and overall experience. From here we made adjustments with button placements and other UI elements to improve the overall user experience.
